KAUSTUBH CHAVAN

Data Engineer Mobile: +91 9867004490 | Email: kaustubh.chavan89@rediffmail.com | Location: Thane, Mumbai Portfolio: https://github.com/kpc12/

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY Data Engineer with 12 years of IT experience and 4 years specializing in Data Engineering. Strong expertise in ETL processes, data warehousing, big data technologies, data analytics, and reporting. Proven track record of helping organizations drive decision-making by unlocking insights from complex data systems.

TECHNICAL SKILLS Big Data: Hadoop (HDFS, YARN), Apache Spark, Hive, Delta Lake | Cloud: AWS Programming: SQL, Scala, Python | ETL & Tools: Airflow, Unix/Linux, Sqoop, GitHub, Postman

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Big Data Training Consultant | Freelancer | Aug 2025 – Present

Deliver training on big data technologies including Hadoop, Spark, and data engineering best

practices

Mentor professionals in SQL, Python, and Scala Spark with hands-on guidance • Design curriculum for data engineering courses and support real-world application learning

Senior Software Engineer | Circana | Jan 2024 – Aug 2025

Developed data transformations including pivots, incremental loads, and CDC using Scala

Spark

Implemented Delta Lake solutions for data versioning and integrated data from RDBMS, APIs,

and S3

Managed data warehousing with Amazon Redshift and orchestrated pipelines using Apache

Airflow

Built Scala based functional packages to perform ETL operations.

Used Scala based Testing Framework FunSuite, FlatSpec

Data Engineer | Finicity, a Mastercard Company | Feb 2021 – Jan 2024

Built ETL pipelines using Scala Spark on AWS Glue and managed Hadoop ecosystem (HDFS,

Hive, Spark)

Optimized data structures using partitioning and bucketing in Hive • Automated workflows and scheduled jobs using Apache Airflow

Associate | Suryoday Small Finance Bank | Sept 2020 – Dec 2020

Automated SQL scripts in MSSQL Server and performed data import/export using Sqoop • Executed Spark jobs on cluster environments and queried OLAP systems using Hive-Spark connections

Senior Analyst | Capgemini Technology | June 2019 – May 2020

Performed database analysis using Spark SQL and implemented workflow orchestration using

Airflow

Designed data pipelines for structured and semi-structured data formats

MIS Executive | Ipca Laboratories | July 2017 – June 2019

Generated automated MIS reports and conducted data analysis using SQL

MIS Assistant | Meyer Organics | Feb 2016 – July 2017

Performed data analysis for sales operations and prepared reports for sales teams

Computer Faculty | ICIT Computer Institute | May 2015 – Feb 2016

Taught C, C++, Core Java, HTML, and SQL to students

EDUCATION Bachelor of Science in Information Technology (B.Sc. IT) | Graduated: 2013
